input: Draft a sponsorship proposal for my sports team

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Sponsorship Proposal for Your Sports Team
gold.taskDescription: Create a compelling sponsorship proposal document to attract potential sponsors for the user's sports team.

questions.title: What sport and level does your team compete at?
questions.description: Understand the sport type (football, basketball, swimming, etc.) and the competitive level (amateur, semi-pro, youth league, college, etc.).

questions.title: Who are the specific sponsors you are targeting?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has specific companies in mind or needs help identifying potential sponsor categories.

questions.title: What sponsorship amount or tier are you asking for?
questions.description: Clarify the monetary value or sponsorship packages being proposed (e.g., title sponsor at $10,000, bronze tier at $500).

questions.title: What will sponsors receive in return for their support?
questions.description: Determine the benefits offered to sponsors such as logo placement, social media mentions, event signage, or ticket packages.

questions.title: How large is your team's audience or fan following?
questions.description: Gather data points like number of fans, social media followers, average game attendance, or local media coverage to demonstrate reach.

questions.title: What is the deadline for submitting this proposal?
questions.description: Establish the urgency and timeline so the plan can be prioritized and scheduled appropriately.

questions.title: Do you have an existing proposal template or brand guidelines?
questions.description: Find out if there are existing documents, logos, color schemes, or formats that the proposal must align with.
